notes: I added two new m-drop conditions revealed by E8: drop a lowercase 'm' at the **start** of a word (needed for "maximum"→"axiu", "minimum"→"iniu") and drop it when **followed by 'u'** (needed for the mid-word m in those same words, while keeping the m in "amixed"). The start-of-word rule is well-supported; the "before-u" rule is my best guess (marked "?") since the evidence only shows it in "maximu
